purpose: Controlled smoke of the blind API evaluation workflow, not a general usability benchmark or statistical estimate

isolation.consumer_context: New spawn_agent with fork_turns none for every trial
isolation.filesystem: Procedural allowlist on a shared host, not enforced filesystem isolation
isolation.consumer_condition_blinding: Trial paths for development consumers contained condition names; no author reasoning, private rubric or prior attempts were supplied
isolation.judge_condition_blinding: Final grades use randomized opaque sample IDs and sanitized internal trace paths
isolation.audit_limit: Self-recorded command logs and artifact checks; complete filesystem-read audit and tool metadata unavailable

judgment_events.issue: Some copied logs exposed baseline/candidate labels through internal paths.
judgment_events.resolution: Retain old grades as superseded; regrade all development trials with fresh judge, randomized opaque IDs and redacted internal trace paths.

harness_events.issue: Initial checker used -e argv positions when executed as a file; detected self-import and exited before grading.
harness_events.fix: Use file-execution argv positions; rerun checks against unchanged consumer artifacts and expected cases.

general_fix_rules.evidence: Baseline literal-key consumer tried unsupported forms, then adapted records to a simple alias; correctness passed but discovery scored 1/2
general_fix_rules.rule: Publish the literal-key grammar and a diagnostic that points to it; test punctuation-bearing keys with a fresh consumer

general_fix_rules.pattern: Version labels survive neutral directory wrappers
general_fix_rules.evidence: An independent judge noticed original trial directory names inside commands.log
general_fix_rules.rule: Sanitize internal paths and headers, preserve raw originals, and regrade with a new judge after exposure

general_fix_rules.pattern: Intentional TDD Red treated as API retry
general_fix_rules.evidence: Ordinary and repeated consumers used missing/unimplemented consumer tests before Green
general_fix_rules.rule: Separate planned Red/Green execution from retries caused by public-interface uncertainty

general_fix_rules.pattern: Normal stack snippets confused with source inspection
general_fix_rules.evidence: A query syntax error emitted a normal JavaScript stack snippet
general_fix_rules.rule: Permit ordinary diagnostics as interface feedback while forbidding deliberate implementation-file inspection

independent_skill_forward_check.type: Grading/planning-only behavioral test on synthetic review records

tool_disabled_narration_and_reused_holdo.decision: Execution unverified; 100% not an empirical result; reused holdout becomes development data; no convergence claim

stopping.basis: Two consecutive candidate development rounds met frozen per-task 100% rubric and critical/oracle gates; held-out final check passed
limits: One fresh consumer per task per round, reduced from the skill default of two
Same inherited model/harness; exact model identity and usage metadata unavailable
Procedural public-surface blinding; development consumer paths exposed condition labels
Toy filtering/projection and embedded comparison DSL only; no general human usability inference
Historical holdout is now published as replay/regression data and cannot be treated as a new unseen holdout
